questions.question: After swapping `createStore` for `configureStore`, a legacy reducer starts throwing 'A state mutation was detected inside a dispatch'. What does this mean?
options: configureStore is incompatible with switch reducers
The reducer has always mutated state; configureStore's development immutability check now reveals it
Immer is converting the reducer incorrectly
The action type constant is not a string
questions.explanation: configureStore adds an immutability check in development. The mutation bug existed before; it was simply unnoticed.

questions.question: During migration, how can a new slice keep handling actions dispatched with the old `ADD_TODO` constant?
options: It cannot; every call site must change first
Use the removed object syntax for extraReducers
questions.explanation: extraReducers can respond to any action type string, so old dispatch sites keep working while new code uses slice action creators.

questions.question: A `mapState` returned `{ user, count }`. After converting to `useSelector((s) => ({ user: s.auth.user, count: s.cart.items.length }))`, the component re-renders on every action. Why?
options: Hooks always re-render on every action
useSelector compares with === by default, and the selector returns a new object each time; connect compared shallowly
questions.explanation: connect shallow-compares the mapState result. useSelector uses reference equality, so a new object every time forces a re-render. Use separate useSelector calls or pass shallowEqual.

questions.question: Which statement about the RTK 2 / Redux 5 upgrade is correct?
options: Thunk must be added manually to configureStore
The object syntax for extraReducers was removed; use the builder callback
questions.explanation: RTK 2 removed the object syntax for createReducer and extraReducers. connect is still supported, thunk is included by default, and action types must be strings.
